title: Finance: Interest, Banking and Loans
summary: Simple and compound interest, interest rates on savings and loans, bank fees and account types, hire purchase, and comparing loan options.

rows: the original amount plus interest already earned
Grows by the same amount each year (linear)

notes.text: In Mathematical Literacy, compound interest is usually calculated year by year in a table, although the formula $A = P(1 + i)^n$ gives the same answer.

items: **Cheque or current account**: for everyday transactions, debit orders and card payments; monthly fees.
**Fixed deposit**: money is locked away for a set time at a higher interest rate.
Fees may be **pay-as-you-use** (a fee per transaction) or a **fixed monthly bundle**.

notes.title: Worked example 1: comparing bank fees
notes.problem: Bank A charges R5,50 per withdrawal and R60 per month. Bank B charges R110 per month with unlimited transactions. For how many withdrawals per month are they equal?
notes.answer: About 9 withdrawals; for more than 9, Bank B is cheaper.

notes.text: **Hire purchase (HP)** lets you take goods home after paying a **deposit**, and pay off the rest in monthly instalments that include interest. Buying on credit always costs more than paying cash.

notes.title: Worked example 2: hire purchase
notes.problem: A lounge suite costs R12 000 cash. On HP, you pay a 10% deposit and 24 instalments of R620. How much extra does HP cost?

notes.label: Be careful with credit
notes.text: Store cards and personal loans often have very high interest rates. Missing payments damages your **credit record**, which makes future loans harder and more expensive to get.

questions.prompt: Calculate the simple interest on R6 000 at 7% p.a. for 4 years.

Which account usually earns the highest interest rate?
A TV costs R7 500 cash. On HP: R750 deposit plus 18 payments of R480. How much more than the cash price is paid on HP?
A pay-as-you-use account charges R4,50 per transaction plus R45 a month. A bundle account costs R99 per month. Which is cheaper for a customer who makes 15 transactions a month?
questions.memo:
✓ PAYU: R45 + 15 × R4,50 = R112,50 (1)
✓ Bundle: R99 (1)
✓ The bundle is cheaper (1)
